title: The Guru Decrees Gurbakhsh Singh's Return to the Panth

blocks.text: The heavenly dialogue resumes with Gurbakhsh Singh still intent on remaining among the martyrs. Did he pray to God for an abode among the martyrs, yet the reply redirects that longing toward future service rather than permanent rest in the celestial assembly.

The Guru's answer is decisive: That he must take birth again to be with Khalsa Panth. His martyrdom has earned him authority, so the closer he had stepped toward death in battle, the greater the host and leadership that will one day stand under his charge.

The page closes by linking sacrifice to command. The martyrs acknowledge his new station, and the promise is made that his death before the Giljas has not ended his role, but prepared him to return as a leader whose courage will again serve the Panth in history.
